summary.text: Nate Blouin is a Democratic member of the Utah State Senate for District 13 in Salt Lake County, serving since January 1, 2023. The Legislature's roster lists his profession as renewable energy advocate.

paragraphs.text: Blouin earned an associate degree from Salt Lake Community College, a bachelor's degree from the University of Utah and a Master of Public Administration from Brown University, according to the Utah Legislature's roster.
The roster lists him as a member of the SLCC Alumni Leadership Council, the Salt Lake County Open Space Trust Fund Committee and Friends of Alta.
